prompt:
Use aged paper, restrained sepia color, halftone print texture, and archival cutout framing.
Treat photographs and documents as tactile evidence layers with legible hierarchy.
Avoid: Glossy modern gradients, neon color, and playful preschool proportions.
Composition: Organize evidence in measured overlapping planes with one dominant archival focal point.
Composition: Preserve readable margins, captions, and document edges instead of filling every gap.
Create an exquisite fine-art paper collage in exact landscape 1672x941. Aged ivory paper, muted indigo printed photographic textures, restrained amber light, handmade ragged edges, shallow physical paper shadows. Poetic wind and passing time: an old empty seaside lane receding diagonally through torn indigo archival photo strips, several blank ivory page corners sweeping toward the upper right as a carefully composed still collage. A faint ochre moon, cool mist, beautiful sparse composition. Keep the middle legible. No words, letters, text, logos, people or watermarks. Bottom 18 percent quiet ivory for editable Chinese lyrics. Gallery quality and rich tactile detail, no digital glossy effects.
